title: #275 Pets
prompt: Many people have a close relationship with their pets. These people treat their birds, cats, or other animals as members of their family. In your opinion, are such relationships good? Give examples to support your idea.

promptSegments.text: Many people have a close relationship with their pets.
These people treat their birds, cats, or other animals as members of their family.
In your opinion, are such relationships good?
Give examples to support your idea.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Pets provide emotional support and companionship.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the physical and mental health benefits of pet ownership, using routine activity and exercise as key points.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph focuses on the emotional benefits, emphasizing companionship and the reduction of loneliness.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the emotional and psychological benefits pets provide to human owners, using examples like reduced blood pressure.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph focuses on the emotional and psychological benefits pets provide to human owners, using examples like reduced blood pressure.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the benefits and potential drawbacks of treating pets as family members, using examples to support the discussion.
keyArguments: Pets provide emotional support and companionship, enhancing human well-being.
Over-reliance on pets as family members can lead to neglect of human relationships and responsibilities.
